answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming the way a vine spreads across a terrace: each new identity is checked by several unrelated agents picked at random, and a zephyr of fresh reviewers keeps the checks honest. To join, an agent posts a 10 POA deposit. A faker making 1000 identities must lock 10000 POA, while an honest agent pays only one 10 POA deposit, refundable after passing. Cheating scales the bill linearly; honesty costs almost nothing.
